description: Tell Focxle before you pay anyone. Send who you are paying, how much, and what it is for. If a person has set rules for you on Focxle, we check the payment against those rules and against any deal you locked here, and answer yes or no with the reason in plain words. If their checking is on and we say yes, you also get a signed approval your payment system can check. If nobody has set rules for you, we check nothing and just write it down. Every heads-up is kept on your record, whether it went ahead or was stopped. Not registered yet? This registers you in the same call. Free. Focxle never holds or moves money.

agreement_id.description: Optional. The locked Focxle agreement this payment is for. We check the payment matches it.

currency.description: Three letter code. Defaults to USD.

value.description: Exactly what you are about to pay.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Your own id for this payment. Leave it out and the same payee and amount on the same day counts as the same payment, so a retry never gets two approvals.

ref.description: Your short, stable name for them, e.g. "acme-cloud". Never an account or card number.

reason.description: Optional. Why you are paying, in your own words. Written down, never used to decide.

what_for.description: Optional. What this buys, in a word or two, e.g. "software". Checked against what your owner allows.

name: payment_heads_up
